study.title: The carboligation reaction of acetohydroxyacid synthase II: Steady-state intermediate distributions in wild type and mutants by NMR

question: Can a named AHASII construct connect donor-stage chemistry to overall turnover through a source-qualified intermediate-population model?
conclusion: One Met250Ala/Pyr+Pyr Table2 row connects per-site turnover to four distinct source-derived forward-net stages. The distinction between inferred net constants and microscopic forward rates remains explicit.

reaction.name: pyruvate plus pyruvate to acetolactate and carbon dioxide

participants.name: pyruvate
participants.role: two source-model substrate instances: first donor and second acceptor

reaction.scope: Source-named reaction lineage only, not a fully proton/charge-balanced canonical reaction, isotope atom map or complete elementary mechanism. Both substrate roles refer to pyruvate from the same100mM pool;100mM is not supplied separately for each role.

assays.endpoint: Table2 per-site turnover input and forward-net constants inferred jointly from turnover and acid-quench NMR distributions

turnover.method: Steady-state colorimetric assay for acetoin, as described by the source and its cited methods; Table2 turnover number, not a donor-only trace.
turnover.recipe: 100mM pyruvate except reactant variation;0.1M KPi pH7.6,10mM MgCl2,0.1mM ThDP,75uM FAD.
turnover.normalization: Turnover per site; source assumes two sites in a138kDa heterotetramer (Table1footnote).
turnover.source: PDFp2 general enzyme assays;PDFp3 Table1footnotes;PDFp4 Table2 and results
turnover.table_boundary: Table1 reports3.03s^-1 for His-Met250Ala; selected Table2 reports3±0.1. Do not silently merge the two.

NMR.method: Rapid mixing, acid quench, denatured-protein removal, then1H-NMR of protein-free solution. C6-prime-H integrated areas give relative covalent derivatives; ThDP uses C2-H because its C6-prime-H signal is obscured by FAD.
NMR.pre_mixing_reconstitution: 15mg/mL hexahistidine-fused enzyme,250uM FAD,10mM Mg2+,equimolar active-site ThDP in0.1M KPi pH7.6.
NMR.post_mixing_scope: Do not infer final concentrations from the reconstitution solution without specified mixing volumes. Selected100mM pyruvate is separately stated by Table2/Results.
NMR.quench: Equal volume of12.5%(w/v) trichloroacetic acid/1M DCl inD2O; protocol quenches0.1-10s to check steady state. No exact selected Met250Ala quench time assigned.

assays.uncertainty: Source-reported plus-minus magnitudes are retained without an SD/SEM assignment. Methods attributes the derived net-rate errors to NMR integration; the separate Table2 kcat error basis/statistic is unresolved. Replicate counts, raw fractions and covariance are unavailable.
assays.scope: Composite inference-procedure wrapper preserving the separate turnover and NMR components; not one physical assay or proof of identical preparations.

kcat.uncertainty_context: Printed Table2 plus-minus0.1 is retained with statistic and basis unresolved. kcat is a separate turnover input. The general Methods integration-error statement is not assigned as the origin of this kcat uncertainty; Table1 has a separate5-10% uncertainty description.

inference_context.observed_inputs: Separate source turnover number and relative acid-quench1H-NMR species populations under steady-state conditions.
inference_context.source_model: Cleland transit times:1/kcat=1/k_prime_2+1/k_prime_3+1/k_prime_4+1/k_prime_5. Source Eqs3-5 relate successive species ratios to net-rate ratios;Eqs6-9 derive net rates.
inference_context.substrate_regime: Equations assume steady state and substrate saturation. The source corrects the unsubstituted ThDP fraction for pyruvate nonsaturation using Michaelis-Menten.100mM pyruvate must not be relabeled experimentally fully saturating;Table1 His-Met250Ala apparentKM is36mM. Raw correction inputs/fractions are unavailable for reconstruction.
inference_context.net_definition: A true forward rate multiplied by the fraction of the resulting enzyme form committed to products rather than reversal (source Discussion).

most_populated_species.reported_context: Met250Ala with pyruvate as sole substrate
most_populated_species.interpretation: Authors identify the covalent product adduct as most populated and infer that liberation is partly rate determining. No project occupancy fraction or isolated liberation mechanism is assigned.

inference_context.arithmetic_scope: A harmonic-sum check of the source-rounded constants is a dependent transcription/model-consistency check, not new evidence. No inverse reconstruction of unreported NMR fractions.
inference_context.source_ambiguity: The main text alternates Arg276 and Arg264 in its separate residue mechanism proposal. No Arg atom/site correspondence is used in this selected Met250Ala relation.

inherited_inquiry.supported: Source reports separate CD/stopped-flow acylphosphonate donor-analogue binding and unchanged acceptor specificity in the named V375A/V375I/F109M panel. V375A reportedly favors the2-KB analogue over the pyruvate analogue.

limits: Source-reported model inference, not a direct binding/transient measurement or experimentally established elementary arrow sequence. No native-pyruvate KD is supplied.
The four net parameters share turnover and NMR inputs and are not four independent experimental confirmations. No numerical population fractions are reconstructed from their rounded values.
Each acid-quenched covalent species can pool forms with and without noncovalently associated substrate or product; quench state is not a full enzymatic microstate.

Source net constants include commitment to product rather than reversal. Lower k_prime_4 can arise from bond making or later k_prime_5; k_prime_5 can include covalent cleavage and product diffusion. No microscopic causal rate or residue energy follows.
Fig5 is a hypothetical E.coli active-site model based on yeast1N0H; Fig6 proposes WT/2-ketobutyrate transition-state interactions. Neither is a Met250Ala/Pyr+Pyr observed arrangement.

No full sequence/specimen authentication, isotope provenance, proton/tautomer graph, project experiment, independent human review, protected protein/mechanism admission or demonstrated design performance.
